description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of various models on the November 2024 AMC 10 and AMC 12 tests, with scores normalized to a maximum of 150. The vertical axis represents the average score, while the horizontal axis lists the different models. The chart includes two sets of bars, one for large models and one for small models, each with error bars indicating the standard deviation. The models are ordered from left to right, starting with "Llama-3-3" and ending with "Phi-4". The scores range from approximately 66.4 for the "Llama-3-3" model to 91.8 for the "Phi-4" model. The "Phi-4" model has the highest average score, followed by "Gemini Pro 1.5" and "Phi-4" with scores of 89.8 and 91.8, respectively. The "Llama-3-3" model has the lowest average score. The error bars suggest variability in the performance of each model, with the "Phi-4" model showing the least variability. The chart does not provide any information on the sorting of the bars or any visual emphasis on specific bars.
